process_inspection.host_snapshot: Current snapshot only; not historical telemetry. No arguments or environments collected.
process_inspection.limitation: Executable names only. Interpreter command lines were deliberately not collected; Python processes cannot be attributed to this attempt. A current snapshot cannot prove historical absence.

limitations: Original command stdout/stderr, traceback, exit code, signal sender, launch command, PID/PPID and start/stop timestamps not retained in the inspected attempt directory.
Filesystem times are observed wall-clock metadata, not authenticated execution timestamps.
Hash agreement is current byte consistency, not independent proof of historical provenance.
